newsitem.title: USA: E.F. Johnson, Motorola unit seek joint pact.
newsitem.headline: E.F. Johnson, Motorola unit seek joint pact.

text.p: E.F. Johnson Co and the Land Mobile Products Sector of Motorola Inc said Tuesday they will submit a joint proposal to upgrade the public safety radio system in the Twin Cities area.

If selected by the state of Minnesota, the new system will improve communication between public safety and government personnel in different counties, cities, departments an agencies, the companies said.
The two companies signed a joint licensing agreement to promote the capability of digital radio communication systems in October of 1994.
Motorola shares were trading up 1-7/8 Tuesday at 57-5/8.
